einzeiler: Discussing Adam Wingard's new film Onslaught and building the ultimate action movie pack.
kurzfassung: Sean Fennessey and Chris Ryan discuss recent movie news, including box office trends and streaming releases like Mutiny and The Whisper Man. They then break down Adam Wingard's new action movie Onslaught. Later, Wingard and star Michael Biehn join the show to discuss the film's production and their careers.
stichpunkte: Discussion of Jason Statham's Mutiny and the impact of accidental streaming leaks on box office performance.
Review of the Netflix serial killer thriller The Whisper Man, starring Robert De Niro and Adam Scott.
Introduction to Adam Wingard's new action film Onslaught, a homage to 80s and 90s action and survivalist cinema.
Creation of the 'Black-and-Chrome Action Pack,' highlighting gritty, percussive, and sci-fi-leaning action movies.
Comparison of modern streaming movies versus traditional theatrical event releases and the role of VOD.
Interview with director Adam Wingard and action icon Michael Biehn discussing their childhood fandom and collaboration on Onslaught.
Michael Biehn shares anecdotes from his decades-long career in Hollywood, working with James Cameron, and his approach to acting.
beschreibung:
Well, ladies and gentlemen, it’s time to take some MDMA, get kinky, and grab some guns because on today’s show, Chris Ryan joins us (duh) to discuss Adam Wingard’s new metal action flick, ‘Onslaught.’ They briefly cover two additional recent releases in ‘Mutiny’ and ‘The Whisper Man’ before diving into ‘Onslaught’ and building out their “Black-and-Chrome Action Movie Pack.” Later, Sean is joined by iconic actor Michael Biehn and Wingard to discuss ‘Onslaught’ as well as the wild personal story that inspired the film and plenty of anecdotes about making movies in Hollywood.
